description.value: PappaRoti is a Malaysian-origin café chain famous for its signature roti buns: a soft, pillowy interior wrapped in a crisp coffee-caramel crust with a salted butter centre, baked fresh throughout the day. The Coquitlam location is one of several BC outposts of a brand with over 400 locations worldwide, serving buns alongside hot and cold drinks, pastries, sandwiches, salads, and soups. It makes a convenient stop on Pinetree Way for a quick, filling snack.
